line.en: the cfl final, kickoff 5pm mountain time. there is no public parking at the stadium, so take transit or a ride share.
line.de: das cfl-finale, anpfiff 17 uhr mountain time. am stadion gibt es keinen öffentlichen parkplatz, also bahn oder fahrdienst nehmen.
line.tr: cfl finali, başlama saati 17:00 mountain saati. stadyumda halka açık otopark yok, toplu taşıma ya da araç paylaşımı kullan.

sparks.why: 113th Grey Cup at McMahon Stadium, Sun Nov 15, 5pm MT per the CFL; no public parking per greycupfestival.ca FAQ.
